title: Gold
text:
Gold

# Gold (Au)

Atomic number:

79

Atomic weight:

196.9665

Average concentration in ocean:

50 fmol/kg

Residence time:

1000 yrs

 Distribution in ocean The concentrations of gold are so low that analytical uncertainty makes it difficult to determine the vertical concentration profile precisely (data). At one time, there were plans to recover gold from seawater to repay Germany's debt from World War I. These data show that the concentrations are too low to make this feasible. One cubic kilometer of seawater contains about 10 g of Au, worth only $100. Speciation AuCl 2 - or AuOH(H 2 O) Residence time The gold residence time was calculated to be 1000 years by Faulkner and Edmond (1990).

Analysis Quantification by ICP-MS after preconcentration by anion exchange. References
